non_retroactive: Applies to claims registered after effective_from_utc. E006, E007 and E008 results keep their original labels and are not reinterpreted.
level_rule: Levels are independent states. A level can only be PASS if every lower level is PASS. A compression PASS never implies a language or semantic PASS: those levels stay NOT_TESTED until their own evidence blocks are supplied.

registration.rule: All hashes must be registered in a commit that precedes the first final evaluation. Missing retraction condition or missing hash => FAIL at registration.

holdout_protection.rule: A folio that any prior experiment used for model selection, threshold determination or error analysis (role SELECTION) can never be part of a confirmation lockbox. Folios used only for evaluation are SEMI_INDEPENDENT and are flagged as such. Fully untouched data are INDEPENDENT. The claim record must name a lockbox_id from the registry; overlap with SELECTION folios => FAIL.

compression.metric: description length of the OBSERVED Voynich text in bits per token (not perplexity of a produced plaintext)
compression.null_model: the strongest frozen null registered for the lockbox (currently P70 layer A; its historical values 15.03 global / 14.42 dev->holdout are references, not thresholds)
compression.model_bits_rule: All components must be present (numbers >= 0). total_candidate_bits = data_bits + sum(components). Comparison uses total bits per token for the candidate and data+model bits for the null.
compression.reconstruction_rule: The candidate must reconstruct the observed lockbox text exactly; sha256 of the reconstruction must equal sha256 of the lockbox text. Otherwise the level is NOT_TESTED.

ci.method: percentile bootstrap of the folio-level mean paired difference

margin_bits_per_token.rule: Must be calibrated and justified on development data only; the claim record states margin, calibration source and justification. A margin calibrated on lockbox data => FAIL.

decision.PASS: n_folios >= min_folios AND mean_delta >= margin AND ci_lower > 0 AND specificity PASS
decision.FAIL: n_folios >= min_folios AND ci_upper < margin (candidate clearly below margin) OR specificity FAIL

specificity.rule: The unchanged candidate is evaluated on each control text against the same null. If its gain on any control is >= (real gain - margin), specificity FAILs: the candidate gains for reasons unrelated to the manuscript's content.

language.rule: Mechanism level PASS required. A fixed language model per candidate language, trained on independent corpora (hashes registered), applied through the fixed mechanism; the target language must beat every alternative language (>= 3 alternatives from different families) on the lockbox by the registered margin with ci_lower > 0; and the same pipeline must NOT prefer the target language on the nonsemantic_generator control.

semantic.pre_registration: Text-derived statements are hashed before any illustration of the tested pages is inspected (predictions sha256 in registration).
semantic.test: Each prediction family is scored against matched wrong pages (controlled permutations within similar sections). Permutation p-value per family; Holm correction across families; target alpha 0.01 after correction.
semantic.min_effect_rule: The pre-registered minimum effect over controls must be met in addition to p <= 0.01.
semantic.error_rate_rule: No true word error rate may be claimed (no known Voynich plaintext). Error rates are measured on synthetic positive controls only and reported as such.

confirmation.rule: Levels 1-4 PASS AND independent replication (different implementer, registered hash) AND transliteration robustness (ZL3b plus IT2a and, where available, GC/v101; aligned loci only; separate results for clear and uncertain passages; same direction with ci_lower > 0 on clear passages) AND retraction condition evaluated and not triggered.

falsification.rule: Every registered claim carries a retraction_condition. No post-hoc exceptions, no scoring-method change, no retuning after the final lockbox is opened. A claim record with post_reveal_changes = true => FAIL.
